description: This file provides utility functions for managing authentication tokens in local storage, including getting, setting, and clearing access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token from local storage.

methods.name: setTokens
methods.description: Stores access and refresh tokens in local storage.

methods.name: clearTokens
methods.description: Removes stored access and refresh tokens from local storage.
